answer: Use device-bound anonymous credentials. A trusted enclave signs a fresh nonce with a chip-unique key; the issuer blinds the credential so payouts stay unlinkable, and the enclave's counter becomes a one-time nullifier. Each epoch accepts it once: a copied image replays the counter and fails, a second image needs a second chip. A sybil oasis on one host hits a ceiling because renting k keys creates no counters. Forging quotes means breaking attestation or buying k copper devices, each with its own nonce trail. Honest agents keep a falcon's-eye identity private; pay follows devices, not claims.
